items.title: David Murray interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, September 18, 2003
items.q: So he comes out on the road and he never wants to spend his money, so I always say like okay, but I always keep a tab on him.

ctx.x: That’s great. You seem to have the most wide open ears I can imagine. Even—

Berkeley man. It really is Berkeley man. I don’t have any control over that. And I think it’s just the way I grew up. I couldn’t be any other way. Right now I’m trying to hear stuff, like being in Paris, I hear all kinds of stuff. There’s a 24-year-old guitar player that’s from Senegal, his name is Herve Samb. And his mother is Vietnamese. And he’s a mixed kid. This kid, I think if there’s another Jimi, he’s going to be it. I’ve never seen anybody like that. So there’s people all over the world man, if you could…
That’s good. Good to have those kind of people in your back pocket.
